payload.reason: The evidence discusses various NLG tasks and evaluation metrics used in the field.

claims.text: NLG tasks considered include readability and grammaticality evaluation, summarization, and text simplification.
Automatic evaluation measures such as BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR are used to evaluate NLG systems.
The paper focuses on end-to-end, data-driven NLG methods that learn sentence planning and surface realization.
